Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to enable multiple baselines for a project in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026.

How does this affect me?
Multiple baselines provide a clear historical view of how a user's project plan evolves over time without losing earlier snapshots. This allows users to track changes in scope, schedule, cost, and effort across different stages of the project and understand the impact of each adjustment.

When this feature is enabled in the feature control settings, users can:
  • Create and store multiple baselines per project.
  • Include relevant metadata in each baseline.
  • Support baseline versioning and enable marking one as the primary baseline for variance tracking.
  • Provide UI options to compare and manage baselines.
  • Extend the feature for analytics and reporting purposes.
What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Enable multiple baselines for a project.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable multiple baselines for a project
